facts.text: Grace College offers a 3-year accelerated bachelor degree option for students in nearly every major, as well as a combined bachelor's and master's degree in four years.

sources.title: Accelerated Bachelor Degree - Accelerated Masters Program
sources.quote: For students in nearly every major, Grace College is proud to offer a 3-year accelerated bachelor degree option. You can also get your bachelor's and master's degree combined in four years.
